item.title: H.S. BOYS BASKETBALL: Eagles soar over North Schuylkill to secure league playoff spot

item.description: Greater Hazleton Area and beyond Hazleton Art League’s Annual Member Show: Exhibition, Jan. 30 through Feb. 22. Hayden Family Center for the Arts, 31 W. Broad St., Hazleton. Opening reception, 5 to 8 p.m. Friday, Jan. 30. The Members’ Exhibition is one of the Art League’s most popular events of the year, showcasing the talent of local artists. item.title: OPINION: Enough with the ‘CEO’ jabs at Eagles coach Nick Sirianni
item.description: The term “CEO head coach,” which is a head coach who doesn’t call plays on either side of the ball, has often been used as a backhanded slight to marginalize coaches’ accomplishments. Exhibit A: Nick Sirianni.

item.title: DISTRICT 2 TEAM WRESTLING: Patriots edge Cougars in Class 3A semis
item.description: HAZLE TWP. — As anticipated, not much separated Pittston Area and Hazleton Area in their District 2 Class 3A Team Wrestling Tournament semifinal on Wednesday. In fact, the scoreboard high above the mat on the side walls at Hughie McGeehan Gymnasium read 35-35 after the final bout. The No. 5-seeded Patriots, however, emerged victorious and secured a berth in Saturday’s finals against Abington Heights by a criteria decision: seven victories to six for the top-seeded Cougars. item.title: Today in History: January 29, Bush warns of ‘axis of evil’
item.description: President George W. Bush said terrorists were still threatening America — and warned of “an axis of evil” consisting of North Korea, Iran and Iraq.

item.title: WEDNESDAY REWIND: Wreckers work overtime to beat Lourdes
item.description: Ian Mckeegan scored five of his team-high 20 points in overtime as Weatherly outlasted Lourdes, 74-71, in a Schuylkill League Division II boys’ basketball game, Wednesday, in Coal Twp. Corbin Wagner added a conventional three-point play in the extra session, part of his 18-point night for the Wreckers.
